collection.title: Demo School Question Bank
collection.description: Curated exemplar questions covering high-frequency CBSE Class 11 and 12 STEM concepts.
collection.scopeLabel: 5 sample questions across Physics & Chemistry — Class 11–12

items.subject: Physics
items.body: A projectile is fired horizontally with a speed $v_0$ from the top of a cliff of height $h$. Find the expression for the horizontal distance $R$ travelled before striking the ground.

items.subject: Physics
items.body: State the work-energy theorem for a variable force. Show that for a conservative force field, the mechanical energy $E = K + U$ remains conserved throughout motion.

items.subject: Chemistry
items.body: The rate constant for a first order reaction doubles when the temperature increases from $300\text{ K}$ to $310\text{ K}$. Calculate the activation energy $E_a$ of the reaction ($R = 8.314\text{ J K}^{-1}\text{ mol}^{-1}$).

items.subject: Physics
items.body: Faraday's law states that the magnitude of induced electromotive force (EMF) in a circuit is proportional to the time rate of change of magnetic flux through the circuit. Lenz's law gives the polarity.

items.subject: Chemistry
items.body: **OIL RIG**: Oxidation Is Loss of electrons, Reduction Is Gain of electrons. Alternatively: **LEO the lion says GER** (Loss of Electrons = Oxidation, Gain of Electrons = Reduction).
